added.description:
Description

Job Summary:

We are looking for a visionary and technically strong Director of Software Engineering to lead our engineering teams in building scalable, secure, and high-performance software solutions. This role is pivotal in shaping our technical strategy, driving engineering excellence, and delivering innovative products in a fast-paced, tech-driven environment.

Responsibilities

Leadership & Strategy
Define and execute the engineering roadmap in alignment with company goals and product strategy, and technical leadership.
Lead and mentor tech leads, software and QA engineers across multiple teams.
Foster a high-performance culture focused on innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Establish clear goals, metrics, and accountability frameworks for engineering teams

Technical Oversight
Help guide architectural decisions and ensure adherence to modern software engineering principles.
Champion best practices in software design, testing, deployment, and operations.
Evaluate and implement new technologies to improve scalability, reliability, and developer productivity.

Project & Product Delivery
Collaborate with leadership, design, and the Product Delivery Office to deliver high-quality software on time and within scope.
Strong command of SDLC best practices, agile methodologies, and application lifecycle management
Ensure robust monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices are in place.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years in a leadership role.
Proven experience leading engineering teams in a technical product or SaaS company.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
Deep understanding of cloud-native architectures (AWS and Azure), microservices, and distributed systems.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence across departments.
Experience with Agile, Scrum, or SAFe methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with security and compliance standards (e.g., FedRAMP, PCI, etc.)
Background in AI/ML, data engineering, or platform engineering is a plus.

About the Organization Eccalon provides global solutions to the most challenging technological issues of the 21st-century, and our evolving portfolio spans five major markets: Machine Learning, Cybersecurity, Aerospace & Defense, Material Sciences, Advance Manufacturing, Sports Science, Biotechnology, and Health & Life Sciences.

Why Join Us?

Eccalon's Executives foster a supportive work environment allowing our teams to thrive, and have a fierce dedication to innovation, security, and people. Our culture is built on inclusion, teamwork, trust, and we are committed to offering career advancement opportunities to all employees. Encouraging a healthy and balanced life, we offer an extensive benefits package to support the wellness of our employees and their families. You will be joining a team of innovators, working with cutting edge technologies, supporting mission critical projects, and making an impact.

Apply today to advance your career!

added.title: Cyber - Operational Technology - Senior Manager - Consulting
added.description:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

Organizations are connecting industrial operations, modernizing control environments and integrating OT with enterprise technology. These changes create new cybersecurity, resilience and regulatory challenges across critical infrastructure and industrial sectors.

As an OT Cybersecurity Senior Manager in Technology Consulting, you will lead client engagements that assess, design and improve cybersecurity for Operational Technology and Industrial Control System environments. You will combine practical OT security knowledge with engagement leadership, client advisory, team development and business development. You will work across engineering, operations, cybersecurity and technology teams to help clients protect critical operations while supporting safety, availability and reliability.

Your Key Responsibilities

Lead OT cybersecurity engagements, including maturity and risk assessments, architecture and configuration reviews, vulnerability assessments, security strategy, transformation roadmaps and implementation support.
Assess industrial environments that may include ICS, SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU, HMI, SIS and IIoT technologies, industrial networks and supporting infrastructure.
Guide the design and implementation of practical OT security controls, including network segmentation, zones and conduits, defense in depth, system hardening, secure remote access, asset visibility, security monitoring and incident response capabilities.
Apply recognized OT cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including ISA/IEC 62443 and NIST SP 800-82. Apply NIST CSF and sector-specific requirements when relevant to the client environment.
Lead client workshops and technical discussions with operational, engineering, cybersecurity and executive stakeholders. Translate technical findings into clear operational and business risk implications.
Manage engagement scope, workplans, resources, risks, quality, timelines and budgets. Keep client and EY stakeholders informed of progress and expected outcomes.
Lead, coach and develop engagement team members. Review deliverables and promote a collaborative, quality-focused and safety-aware working environment.
Build trusted client relationships and identify opportunities where EY can provide additional value.
Support business development through proposals, client presentations, solution shaping, methodology development, thought leadership and reusable assets.
Stay current on OT threat activity, industrial vulnerabilities, evolving regulations, security technologies and leading practices.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Deep understanding of OT and ICS cybersecurity principles and the operational priorities that distinguish industrial environments from enterprise IT.
Ability to lead complex client engagements and communicate with plant, engineering, security and executive stakeholders.
Working knowledge of industrial network architectures, industrial protocols and security controls used in OT environments.
Ability to turn technical observations into practical, prioritized recommendations that consider safety, availability, reliability and business continuity.
Strong project management, analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, written communication and presentation skills.
Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams.

To qualify for the role, you must have

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Industrial Automation or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Approximately 8+ or more years of relevant cybersecurity, OT security, industrial automation or related experience.
Experience leading or managing OT cybersecurity assessments, architecture reviews, security improvement programs or implementation initiatives.
Practical knowledge of OT and ICS environments, industrial networking and systems such as SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU or HMI.
Experience applying ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82 or comparable OT cybersecurity guidance.
Experience developing high-quality client reports, presentations, roadmaps, security designs, policies, standards or implementation documentation.
Experience leading teams, managing client expectations and delivering work within agreed timelines and budgets.
Ability and willingness to travel based on client and project needs.

Ideally, you'll also have

Hands-on experience with OT monitoring, asset visibility or threat detection platforms such as Nozomi Networks, Claroty, Dragos, Armis, Microsoft Defender for IoT, Cisco Cyber Vision or comparable technologies.
Experience in one or more industrial sectors such as power and utilities, oil and gas, manufacturing, chemicals, mining, transportation, water or other critical infrastructure.
Experience with OT incident response, cyber resilience, threat modeling, security testing or vulnerability management in industrial environments.
Relevant certifications such as GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443, GRID, CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCNA or comparable credentials.
Experience supporting pursuits, proposals, account development, methodology development or practice-building activities.

What We Look For

We are looking for professionals who combine OT and ICS technical credibility with practical consulting judgment. Successful candidates communicate clearly, collaborate across engineering, operations and cybersecurity teams, and deliver high-quality outcomes in complex industrial environments.

Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. Walk On Ventures (WOV) is a strategic growth advisory and venture firm partnering with founders and executive teams who are building high-impact, scalable businesses. Operating at the intersection of performance marketing, insurtech, and agentic AI, WOV embeds directly with leadership to create operating leverage and accelerate outcomes. WOV works with teams navigating complexity, rapid expansion, or capital events who seek an experienced partner. Guided by the “Walk On Mentality,” the firm shows up with exceptional preparation, effort, and performance for every client, every day.
Role Description
The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) is a full-time remote role responsible for defining and leading the overall technology vision and execution across Walk On Ventures and its portfolio companies. This role oversees software and product development initiatives, partners with founders and executive teams to design scalable architectures, and aligns technology strategy with business and venture goals. The CTO will manage technical roadmaps, guide project delivery, and ensure that systems, data, and infrastructure are secure, reliable, and built to scale. Day-to-day responsibilities include collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders, mentoring technical leaders, evaluating emerging technologies in agentic AI and insurtech, and driving continuous improvement in engineering practices. The CTO will also support due diligence for investments, contribute to technology-related advisory engagements, and represent the firm’s technology perspective with clients and partners.
Qualifications

Strong background in Software Development and Product Development, with experience building and scaling modern, cloud-based applications.
Proficiency in IT Strategy and Architecture, including designing scalable, secure, and resilient systems aligned with business objectives.
Demonstrated Project Management skills, with a track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder technology initiatives from concept to delivery.
Experience working in or with insurtech, performance marketing, or AI-driven products is highly beneficial.

added.description:
Forequence is seeking an experienced, entrepreneurial technical leader to join as Co-Founder and Chief Technology Officer. This is a founder partnership with meaningful ownership, not a conventional salaried executive role or outsourced development position.

The Opportunity

Unlike many early-stage opportunities, you will not be starting with only an idea. Forequence already has:

A clearly defined enterprise problem
A developed product vision
Proprietary indices, scoring methodologies, and assessment logic
A growing body of original global research
An early MVP
Ongoing enterprise pilot conversations
Leading research, strategy, positioning, commercial development, and go-to-market
The foundation for a differentiated and defensible category in organizational intelligence

About Forequence

Forequence is an enterprise intelligence platform that helps organizations detect human strain before it becomes burnout, attrition, disengagement, or execution failure. Organizations have become highly sophisticated at measuring productivity, performance, revenue, and output. They remain far less capable of understanding the human capacity sustaining those outcomes. Most workforce platforms tell companies what has already happened. Forequence is being built to help organizations see what is developing beneath the surface, understand where human capacity is under pressure, identify the conditions driving that pressure, and intervene before it becomes an expensive organizational failure. Through proprietary organizational indices, behavioral signals, AI-supported analysis, and enterprise intelligence, Forequence helps leaders make better decisions about people, performance, capacity, and risk.

Meaningful Founder Ownership

You will join as a genuine co-founder with meaningful equity and long-term participation in the value you help create. This is not an advisory title, symbolic ownership, or an employee role disguised as a founder opportunity. The right person will help shape the company's technology, product, strategy, team, fundraising, and future. Equity, vesting, responsibilities, decision rights, intellectual property, and founder expectations will be discussed transparently and formalized properly.

Build From a Stronger Starting Point

You will not be responsible for inventing the problem, researching the market from scratch, creating the brand, defining the initial methodology, and building the technology alone. Forequence already has a substantial body of developed intellectual property, research, scoring logic, product thinking, market positioning, and commercial direction. You will bring the technical depth required to transform those assets into a scalable enterprise platform.

Significant Product Influence

The platform is early enough for you to make foundational decisions. You will have meaningful authority over:

Product architecture
Technical strategy
AI and data infrastructure
Enterprise security and privacy
Engineering standards
Product development priorities
Technical hiring
Platform integrations
Scalability and defensibility
The long-term technology roadmap

A Timely Market Opportunity

Artificial intelligence is accelerating the speed, complexity, and intensity of work. As organizations invest more heavily in automation, productivity, and performance technologies, they will also need better intelligence about the people operating alongside those systems. The central question is no longer only whether companies can increase output. It is whether they can understand the human capacity required to sustain that output. Forequence is positioned at the intersection of enterprise AI, workforce intelligence, organizational performance, people analytics, and human sustainability.

Build the Team and Culture From the Beginning

You will have the opportunity to recruit the early engineering and data team, establish the technical culture, and define how the company builds. You will not inherit a dysfunctional engineering organization, outdated infrastructure, or a deeply embedded development process. The early technical standards will be yours to help create.

The Partnership

As Co-Founder And CTO, You Will Work Directly With The Founder To Build Forequence Into a Scalable Enterprise Company. The Partnership Will Include

Meaningful co-founder equity
Shared responsibility for company direction
Direct influence over major product and business decisions
A clear division of ownership based on complementary strengths
Transparent founder agreements and vesting
Participation in fundraising and investor conversations
The opportunity to build and lead the technical organization
Long-term involvement in the commercial value created by the platform

What You Will Own

Technology — Define the architecture, engineering roadmap, infrastructure, development standards, and technical direction of Forequence.
Product Development — Translate proprietary research, indices, assessment logic, and enterprise requirements into a functional, intuitive, and commercially viable platform.
AI and Data — Develop the systems required to identify patterns, surface insights, support organizational decision-making, and responsibly incorporate AI into the product.
Security Readiness — Establish the security, privacy, governance, reliability, and technical controls required to serve enterprise customers.
Validation — Work directly with prospective customers and pilot organizations to refine use cases, test assumptions, prioritize development, and improve the product.
Technical Team — Recruit, lead, and develop the early engineering, data, and technical product team.
Strategy — Contribute to product positioning, pricing, commercial strategy, partnerships, fundraising, and the long-term development of the company.
Capital — Participate in technical due diligence, investor conversations, fundraising strategy, and the articulation of Forequence's technological advantage.

Co-Founder Profile

About

You do not need to meet every requirement. We care more about depth, judgment, learning ability, founder mentality, and alignment than a perfect résumé. You may be a strong fit if you have:

Experience building and shipping complex software products
Worked as a technical founder, CTO, senior engineer, architect, or engineering leader
Strong hands-on technical capability
Experience building B2B SaaS, AI, analytics, data, HR technology, or enterprise platforms
A solid understanding of modern cloud infrastructure, APIs, databases, application architecture, and security
The ability to translate ambiguous problems into practical technical systems
Strong product judgment
Experience working directly with customers or enterprise stakeholders
The ability to recruit and lead technical talent
An understanding of startup constraints and disciplined prioritization
High standards, intellectual honesty, and low ego
The willingness to make a serious long-term commitment to building Forequence

Particularly Relevant Experience

Experience In Any Of The Following Would Be Valuable

Enterprise SaaS
Applied AI or machine learning
Data analytics platforms
People analytics
HR technology
Workforce intelligence
Organizational network analysis
Predictive or risk intelligence
Data visualization
Privacy-sensitive technology
SOC 2 readiness
GDPR or PIPEDA compliance
Enterprise integrations
Early-stage fundraising
Scaling engineering teams

A Note

We are looking for someone who can distinguish between what is technologically impressive and what is commercially necessary.

Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

What You'll Do

You will lead the Database Platform team — the engineering team responsible for the data infrastructure that underpins every NodeZero pentest, finding, and report. NodeZero operates at scale: millions of discovered assets, tens of millions of vulnerability findings, and audit-critical data that our customers rely on to remediate risk. The Database Platform team owns the design, operation, and reliability of our core data layer — currently PostgreSQL as the primary store and Neo4j for the asset graph, with time-series and analytical stores on the roadmap as NodeZero's data volume and use cases grow. You will lead a team of ~8 engineers including a Principal Engineer, and you will build this team from a strong foundation into a fully staffed, world-class data platform organization.

Team Building & Culture: Hire, mentor, and grow the Database Platform team to full capacity. Establish database engineering norms and a culture of ownership for engineers who share responsibility for the most critical data layer in our stack.
Data Architecture: Partner with the Principal Engineer to define the technical direction for NodeZero's data platform — schema design standards, query patterns, migration strategies, and scalability principles.

About The Team

DoorDash’s mission is to grow and empower local economies. By building intelligent, last-mile delivery technology for local cities, DoorDash connects people with the local businesses they care about — helping grow businesses and the communities that support those businesses. The Marketing Technology team is responsible for delivering best-in-class tools, data, and processes so teams at DoorDash can effectively acquire new customers, drive retention, and grow new business lines across all our audiences. Our mission is to enable teams to deliver personalized, engaging, and relevant content across all our owned and paid channels. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Analytics teams to translate Marketing’s technology needs into measurable business outcomes for our Growth and Performance Marketing teams.

The B2B Marketing Technology team does this for DoorDash's business customers. It owns marketing automation, the B2B websites, and the data flows between the tools used by our marketing and sales teams.

About The Role

We're seeking a Senior Manager to lead B2B Marketing Technology at DoorDash. You will own the B2B marketing technology stack: our marketing automation platform, its connection to sales tools, the B2B websites, and the data model and flows that connect them. You will set web and information architecture, define attribution priorities, close data gaps, and redesign our B2B marketing system architecture, building automations yourself when needed. You will lead the B2B MarTech team and partner with B2B Marketing, Go-to-Market Technology, Sales and Operations, Product, Engineering, and Data to set the long-term B2B marketing technology roadmap.

This role will report to the Director, Marketing Technology within the Growth Marketing organization.

You’re Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will…

Own the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for B2B marketing automation across our business lines.
Design how leads move between HubSpot, Salesforce, and the data warehouse, including deduplication, scoring, routing, and lifecycle stages.
Define the marketing data model and attribution priorities with B2B Marketing, Sales and Operations, and Data, and close data gaps across web, marketing automation, CRM, and the warehouse.
Put monitoring, data quality standards, and governance in place so problems are caught before they affect campaigns, lead routing, or reporting.
Set web and information architecture for the B2B websites. This covers the CMS, forms, tracking, tag governance, and the move to AI-native site infrastructure. Define standards rather than fulfilling page requests one at a time.
Run an experimentation program on the B2B websites to improve conversion.
Make keep, add, build, and retire decisions on B2B marketing tools based on cost, usage, and business impact.
Own adoption of the B2B marketing stack, including the processes, training, and documentation that let B2B Marketing teams get full value from HubSpot and the B2B websites.
Lead and grow the B2B MarTech team across web platforms, web development, and marketing operations.
Partner with Go-to-Market Technology on architecture, system ownership, and the Salesforce roadmap.
Serve as B2B Marketing’s technical lead with Product and Engineering, building business cases and prioritizing requests so resources go to the highest-impact problems.
Advise marketing and go-to-market leadership on B2B marketing technology, with clear recommendations as goals and business needs change.
Report on speed of lead handoff to sales, lead-to-pipeline conversion, data reliability, and time to launch.

We’re Excited About You Because You Have…

8+ years in B2B marketing technology, marketing operations, or revenue operations, including 2+ years managing people across technical and operations roles.
Deep expertise with an enterprise marketing automation platform (such as HubSpot, Marketo, or Pardot) and Salesforce, and a strong technical understanding of how marketing systems connect: APIs, webhooks, data warehouses, CMS, and tag management. You can review a system design and identify risks.
Experience designing a marketing data model (objects, fields, lifecycle and lead status, deduplication) and setting attribution and data quality priorities.
Experience owning a B2B marketing website's architecture and improving conversion through experimentation.
Experience selecting and managing B2B marketing and sales tools (such as 6sense, ZoomInfo, Clay, or Chili Piper), including vendor and agency relationships and build, buy, or retire decisions.
A track record of turning marketing requirements into technical specifications with Product and Engineering, and of influencing senior stakeholders without authority by explaining tradeoffs clearly.

Nice to have: experience with data enrichment tools such as HubSpot Data Hub, querying data in Sigma or Tableau, and building automations or integrations, including with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor.

added.title: VP Software Engineering
added.description:
The world needs 3 TW of new solar capacity every year. The legacy approach of developing and building infrastructure is mathematically incapable of catching up.

Planted is the autonomous power deployment company. We transform power plants from bespoke construction projects into manufactured products. By integrating planning software, high-density arrays, energy storage, and field robots, we deliver more power where it's needed most.

The physics are solved; what remains is relentless execution. Led by repeat founders and an engineering core from SpaceX and Tesla, we are backed by Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Piva Capital, Google, Gigascale Capital, Khosla Ventures, and RA Capital Management.

We’re scaling fast and looking for operators and engineers who want to own real pieces of the system. You don't need a traditional energy background; we care whether you can finish hard things. Come build with us.

About The Role

Software is both the brains of our machines and the connective tissue of Planted operations. You will lead and grow a software organization spanning three domains: autonomous robotic vehicle software, our suite of web-based power plant design, build, and operate tools, and an emerging portfolio of AI agents that automate engineering, estimation, and operations workflows.

We are looking for a pragmatic technical leader with a track record of building high-performing, multi-disciplinary software teams. You must be deep enough technically to drive key architectural decisions across the vertically integrated platform, and strategic enough to drive and execute on the product roadmap. You have systems literacy (e.g., how data moves from a robot's camera into an ML pipeline) and prioritize delivery mechanics over heavy-handed project management. Our robots are building projects in the field today and our design software is in front of customers. Your mandate is to scale the product and the team to support our current 10x year over year growth in megawatts deployed.

The Team:
You will join a group at the intersection of deep tech and massive physical infrastructure. Our engineering core brings robotics and automation DNA from SpaceX and Tesla, working directly alongside veteran energy developers. We are led by repeat founders with a successful prior exit (Cogenra to SunPower). Planted is backed by leading investors in energy and Physical AI, including Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Khosla Ventures, and Piva Capital.

The annual salary range for this full-time position is $275,000-$325,000 plus a meaningful equity stake and benefits. Pay within the range is based on candidate experience, job-specific skills, and education. The target experience for the position is 10–15+ years. We work together in person 5 days/week at our HQ in Oakland, CA.

Key Responsibilities

Organizational Leadership & Talent Development: Build, scale, and mentor a high-performing, multi-level software organization, including direct management of engineering managers, principal engineers, and system architects. Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous growth. Recruit and retain top-tier software talent across cloud, spatial/CAD, embedded, and robotics domains while allowing technical experts to own the architecture.
Strategic Execution & Stakeholder Management: Own the software roadmap and drive the predictable, on-time delivery of complex, multi-system software projects across multiple products. Set clear expectations, communicate progress, and align software deliverables. Collaborate seamlessly with the Commercial team, Hardware Engineering, and Project Operations. Make the build-vs-buy, stack, and platform decisions that will hold up at 100x scale.
Software Product Suite Ownership: Lead development across our core platforms: Power Planter (automated layout, engineering, and costing), Build View (autonomous fleet management, field deployment, and QA/QC), and Operate View (inspection, operations, and maintenance tools for large-scale solar plants).
Autonomous Robotic Vehicle Platforms: Lead the engineering teams deploying the full software stack across our autonomous field machine fleet (fleet logic, behavior trees, and path planning, modern and classical controls, ROS2, etc.).
Data Flywheel: We operate our field machines like modern manufacturing lines. You will own the telemetry and data infrastructure that monitors production with statistical process control and turns every installation into training data for better models and improved machine productivity.
AI Systems: Build the team and roadmap for AI agents that automate design, estimation, project delivery, and operations workflows, grounded in the data our robots and projects generate.

Qualifications

10 to 15+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering teams (senior ICs and managers) shipping production systems.
Deep expertise in full stack software development involving hardware and software integration like robotics, IoT, or industrial automation.
Track record shipping robotics, autonomous vehicles, or hardtech software into the field at scale—with a strong focus on fleet reliability, continuous testing, and real-time observability.
Broad leadership capability across platform/full-stack teams, cloud infrastructure, data systems, or applied AI/ML groups outside your core specialty.
Systems architecture judgment with strong understanding of how technologies work together (e.g., middleware, pub/sub architectures, web services, and ML pipelines). You do not need to write the C++ on the robot, but you must understand edge compute, latency, and hardware-in-the-loop testing.

Preferred Qualifications

Field robotics: Experience in construction, agriculture, mining, defense, logistics, or autonomous vehicles operating off-pavement (e.g., Waymo, Cruise, Bedrock Automation).
DevOps & Delivery: Strong understanding of modern software deployment and containerization (Docker). Experience with CI/CD, release pipelines, and edge deployment strategies, focusing on how code reliably gets to the machine.
Agentic and AI-Augmented Software Engineering: Experience building, rebuilding, and managing AI-integrated software development platforms and teams.
Robotics & Controls: Familiarity with the complexities of deploying field-robotics software (e.g., ROS2, vehicle navigation, and autonomy stacks). You understand the unique delivery challenges of robotics compared to traditional software.
Perception & Sensing: Experience with LiDAR, stereoscopic/IR cameras, object detection, spatial mapping, and SLAM in dynamic outdoor environments. Strong understanding of middleware, pub/sub architectures alongside web services, backend technologies, and ML pipelines.
Spatial / CAD Expertise: Deep understanding of software platforms working with geospatial data (GIS, CAD engines, 3D modeling, or automated parametric design).
Industrial Operations: Exposure to automated manufacturing execution systems (MES) managing statistical process control, telemetry monitoring, or fleet analytics in hardtech, renewable energy environments, or advanced manufacturing.

Philosophy On Qualifications And Compensation

Many people only apply for jobs if they believe they can perform every task in the job description. We are most interested in finding the best candidate for the job and will consider equivalent combinations of knowledge, skills, education, and experience. If you are interested in applying, we encourage you to think broadly about your background and skill set for the role.

Additionally, we believe compensation should reflect the value people bring and give them a real stake in what we're building. Our total compensation package includes a base salary, meaningful equity through stock options, and benefits including company holidays, paid time off (PTO), and in-office lunches. Individual pay may vary within the posted range and is determined by a number of factors including relevant experience, skills, and location.

How We Work

We are using sunlight, software, and robots to power the world. It is historic work, and it is hard work. If you want a paved, predictable path, this isn't for you. If you'd rather invent the path, this is the best job you'll ever have.

Call it out. We put big robots in the field alongside our crews and partners. Anyone can stop any operation at any time. The same trust runs everywhere: a bug in the code, a flaw in the plan, a risk in the dirt, a design that no longer makes sense. Say it while it's small and cheap to fix, directly to the person who can fix it. Sometimes that person is you.
Commit and complete. We work problems, not tasks. A confident guess is not a commitment; “I'll find out by Thursday” is. If a date slips, say it early and bring the new plan. Every decision has one owner: bring data, argue hard, push back in the room, then the owner calls it and we lock arms. Execution compounds.
Convention isn't evidence. “Industry standard” is a red flag. Most conventions were answers to constraints that no longer exist. We respect physics and obey the law. Everything else is a choice, and we get to make it.
Let machines do the work. We are system builders: AI and robots do repetitive work in the field and in the office. Every task a machine takes over is a person out of harm's way or off the critical path. Solve a problem once, then build the tool, write the spec, and commit the doc so nobody has to solve it again. Doing it by hand once is fine. Twice means we need a tool.

Planted is an equal opportunity employer committed to growing inclusively, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, medical condition, age, or veteran status. However you identify, or whatever background you bring with you, please apply. We look forward to hearing from you.

The Opportunity

Job Profile Summary

The Assistant Vice President (AVP) of Security Engineering is a senior leadership role responsible for setting the strategic direction and overseeing the execution of security engineering initiatives across the organization. This individual will build a team of distinguished engineers and principals who focus on developing security solutions across priority technology areas, including AI, Cloud, Data and more. This role demands a strong blend of technical expertise, strategic thinking, and people leadership to ensure robust security is embedded throughout the technology lifecycle and to protect the association from evolving threats. This role also requires executive influence skills to partner with other engineering, architecture and development roles from across the technology organization.

The AVP will lead a high performing team, foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement, and act as a key subject matter expert influencing cross-functional security efforts.

This role is remote eligible in the continental U.S. with occasional business travel. However, individuals residing within a 60-mile radius of a USAA office will be expected to work on-site 4 days per week.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Security Engineering Leadership:
Define and drive the security engineering strategy, ensuring security requirements are integrated into all aspects of the solution/application enablement and sustainment lifecycle.
Collaborate with architecture to help define the strategic direction for cross-functional and highly complex key technologies within specific security domains.
Lead the research, analysis, and troubleshooting of highly complex security issues, systems, tools, and vendor integrations, identifying, resolving, and reporting on them.
Advance professional development through active participation in industry organizations, publications, educational opportunities, networking, and professional societies.

Technical Design & Development:
Design, develop, code, integrate, and test complex, cross-functional technical solutions with a primary focus on security, often collaborating with engineers and architects outside of the immediate team/department.
Apply Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices within their security domain to ensure highly available, performant, and secure systems.
Lead the implementation of event-driven security architectures, methods, and controls.
Advise on security architecture, methods, and controls required to meet security, compliance, and audit requirements.

Lead, mentor, and guide a team of security engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning, professional growth, and collaboration.
Ensure the team stays current with the latest security trends and technologies through ongoing development and training.
Conduct code and design reviews to ensure effective operations, accurate planning, and adherence to security best practices.
Drive engineering efficiencies within the team.

Identify and manage existing and emerging risks stemming from business activities, ensuring risks are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.
Collaborate with Security Analysts, IT, and Business Partners to tune, harden, and enhance security solutions and technologies to counter the latest trends and threats.
Ensure Information Security is integrated across the association by conducting comprehensive technology research to evaluate potential vulnerabilities in company systems.

Cross-Functional Influence:
Influence and lead cross-functional efforts across the organization as a subject matter expert in their security domain.
Work closely with IT and Business Partners to ensure security solutions align with business objectives.

Operational Excellence:
Independently resolve complex production issues and lead troubleshooting of end-to-end solutions that span multiple applications and systems.
Install, configure, troubleshoot, and maintain hardware and software related to security infrastructure.

6 years of people leadership experience in building, managing and developing high-performing engineering teams, including performance management, coaching, and professional development.
Ability to foster a positive and high-performing team culture.
Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop junior engineers.
Proven experience leading and driving company-wide technology projects or initiatives.
Demonstrated experience leading and owning security strategies, solutions, and/or initiatives, with a proven ability to drive these efforts to successful completion.
Advanced experience with modern programming/scripting languages and frameworks.
Extensive experience designing, implementing, and leading security engineering activities utilizing modern DevSecOps practices.
Demonstrated ability to address complex production issues by effectively troubleshooting applications and systems.
Experience working with platform engineering concepts, including security best practices in infrastructure/policy as code, security architecture design patterns, security vendor integrations, and CI/CD pipelines with built-in application security controls.
